headline: Nexa Resources Gains 0.8% as Dollar Rallies and Peru Output Recedes
summary: Shares of zinc miner Nexa Resources gained 0.80% while Peruvian precious metals miner Buenaventura dropped 1.20% as the US dollar strengthened and regional mining output rebalanced.
why: Nexa Resources is one of Latin America's largest zinc miners, operating major assets in Peru and Brazil.

impacts.name: Nexa Resources
impacts.why: Modest zinc commodity pricing resilience supported Nexa's equity performance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Currency moves and changing regional metal production figures drove mixed reactions across Latin American mining equities.
